title: Three induced colours on the Mobius ladder M_12: a refutation of the Lau-Shiu-Ng even Mobius ladder local antimagic conjecture
beyond_target: accepted after the campaign target of 40 was reached (additional result #51 toward 60)
exact_endpoint: Mobius.conjecture_false : ¬ (forall n, 4 <= n -> n % 2 = 0 -> Mobius.LocalAntimagicChromaticNumberEq n 4), where LocalAntimagicChromaticNumberEq n k states that the Mobius ladder M_2n (the 2n-cycle with antipodal chords) has a local antimagic labelling (a permutation of 1..3n with distinct sums across every edge) with exactly k distinct vertex sums and that every such labelling has at least k; witnessed by an explicit labelling of M_12 with three sums
scope: chi_la(M_12) = 3 (Lean certifies the failure of the value 4; the matching lower bound 3 is an ordinary odd-cycle argument), refuting Lau-Shiu-Ng Conjecture 3.2 for even n >= 4; remark: chi_la(M_8) = 3 contradicts Lau-Shiu (arXiv:2203.06594, Acta Math. Hungar. 169 (2023)) Theorem 2.4

substantive_reason: It refutes a published conjecture (Lau-Shiu-Ng 2018, retained in the 2021 journal version) on the local antimagic chromatic number of even Mobius ladders with an explicit 18-edge labelling of M_12 using three colours, which is optimal; it also shows that a later published theorem asserting the value 4 for all cubic graphs of order eight is false at M_8. It is a distinct graph family from the accepted 354228 (full trees). Significance is modest.
